Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Francis Ford Coppola "co-created" the main characters of The Godfather. This is a factual error regarding the definition of "creation" in literature and film. Mario Puzo is the sole creator of the characters (Vito and Michael Corleone) in the novel. While Coppola co-wrote the screenplay and directed the film, he adapted existing characters; he did not "create" them. The Planner's final answer ("co-created by Mario Puzo and Francis Ford Coppola") misinterprets the role of a screenwriter/director as a character creator, contradicting the established fact that Puzo is the author who created the characters. This error stems from the Planner's failure to distinguish between "creating a character" (authorship) and "adapting a character" (screenwriting/directing) in its final synthesis.
